locales-list-page.intro: Every language this deployment offers, from both tiers. A language added here can be translated immediately, but the API only answers in it once a dictionary file is deployed.
locales-list-page.scope-api-hint: The API can answer requests in this language — a dictionary file is deployed for it.
locales-list-page.scope-app-hint: A client dictionary is downloadable for this language.
locales-list-page.confirm-delete: Delete "{tag}" and every entry translated into it ({count} entries)? This cannot be undone.

locale-form.hint-tag: e.g. es, pt-BR. Immutable once created — it is what every entry references.
locale-form.hint-active: Off, visitors cannot select the language. You keep seeing and editing it here.
locale-form.hint-create: This registers the language for translation only. The API answers in it once a dictionary file is deployed.
locale-form.tag-invalid: Use a BCP 47 tag: two lowercase letters, with an optional region (es, pt-BR)

locale-entries-page.empty: No entries yet — add one, or import a dictionary
locale-entries-page.key-immutable: A key is the identity a client looks the string up by. Changing it is a delete plus an add.
locale-entries-page.confirm-delete-entry: Remove "{key}" from this language? The other languages keep theirs.
locale-entries-page.success-import: Import done: {created} created, {updated} updated, {removed} removed. Now at revision {revision}.
locale-entries-page.error-merge-removed: The merge reported deleted rows, which a merge must never do. Check the server.
locale-entries-page.empty-hint: Only edited rows are listed here. Every key the app and the API use, edited or not, is on the dictionary board.

locales-dictionary-page.intro: Every key the app and the API use, in every language. Edit a cell and leave it to save; clear a cell to drop that language's override. An italic value is the bundled or deployed text nobody has overridden; an outlined cell has nothing at all.
locales-dictionary-page.empty: No keys yet — add one, or import a dictionary from a language's entries page
locales-dictionary-page.no-languages: No language is registered for translation yet
locales-dictionary-page.confirm-clear: Remove "{key}" from {language}? The other languages keep theirs.
locales-dictionary-page.error-key-exists: That key is already on the board.
locales-dictionary-page.cell-missing: Nothing renders for this key in this language yet.
locales-dictionary-page.cell-baseline-app: This frontend's bundled text. Type to override it.
locales-dictionary-page.cell-baseline-api: The API's deployed text. Type to override it.
locales-dictionary-page.empty-filtered: No key matches — every language has this covered.

entry-form.title: Add an entry
entry-form.hint-key: Flat and dotted, e.g. products.list.title. A key that collides with an existing one — as its prefix or its extension — is refused.

entries-import.title: Import a dictionary
entries-import.intro: Paste or upload a nested JSON dictionary — the same shape as a bundled locale file. It is flattened to dotted keys on import.
entries-import.mode-merge: Merge — upserts what is sent, deletes nothing
entries-import.mode-replace: Replace — the scope becomes exactly this file. What is not sent is DELETED.
entries-import.confirm-replace: Replace every "{scope}" entry of this language with these {count} keys? Anything not in the file is deleted.
